stem:
A coach offered student athletes a choice of four workout sessions. The percentage bar graph shows the percentage of student athletes who attended each workout session.

Which statement best supports the data in the percentage bar graph?

options.label: A
options.text: More than half the students attended the 5:00 p.m. session.

options.label: B
options.text: Fewer students attended a morning session (a.m.) than attended an afternoon session (p.m.).

options.label: C
options.text: Fewer students attended the 6:00 p.m. session than attended the 5:00 p.m. session.

options.label: D
options.text: More than twice as many students attended the 6:00 a.m. session as attended the 5:00 p.m. session.

visual_elements: Percentage bar graph showing attendance at workout sessions with segments for 5:00 a.m., 6:00 a.m., 5:00 p.m., and 6:00 p.m. sessions, labeled with a key indicating black (5:00 a.m.), dark gray (6:00 a.m.), light gray (5:00 p.m.), and white (6:00 p.m.). The bar shows approximately 10% for 5:00 a.m., about 45% for 6:00 a.m., about 30% for 5:00 p.m., and about 15% for 6:00 p.m.
